WASHINGTON - Departing White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt announced on Aug 21 that she will join a pro-Trump political fundraising group when she leaves her post at the end of the month.
The 28-year-old spokeswoman will re-join MAGA Inc., a pro-Trump “super PAC,” or political action committee.

football_and_world.title: Which UEFA competition's league phase will Celtic enter in the 2026–27 season?
football_and_world.background: Celtic are seeking a place in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League through the qualifying playoffs.
football_and_world.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UEFA's official qualification results, corroborated by contemporaneous match reporting.
  • Resolution Rule: Resolve to the European competition whose league phase Celtic qualify for following the completion of their August 2026 Champions League qualifying-playoff tie.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The competition's standard name.

current_state.key_facts: UPDATED Aug 20 (T+5d to Tue Aug 25 Leg 2 in Linz; SUBMITTED UEFA Champions League 0.60->0.94, UEFA Europa League 0.40->0.06; sum=1.00): MAJOR RESULT — On Wed Aug 19 at Celtic Park, Celtic crushed LASK Linz 3-0 in Leg 1 of the UEFA Champions League qualifying play-off (Benjamin Nygren 26', Camilo Duran 38' & 67'; corroborated by Irish Times & Hindustan Times), with no red cards or major Celtic injuries reported. Under post-2021 UEFA rules (no away goals rule), LASK must win Leg 2 at Raiffeisen Arena in Linz by 4+ goals in 90 minutes to advance outright, or by exactly 3 goals to force extra time/penalties (so even 1 Celtic away goal forces LASK to score 4 just for ET). Nuance preventing 0.97+: LASK created several chances in an open match (Moses Usor had a 30-second volley & LASK had a header disallowed for offside; Samuel Adeniran played and forced saves from Viljami Sinisalo; Usor missed two more 2H chances) with Celtic looking open in central midfield post-Arne Engels (debutant Mika Baur started). Fat-tail mixture model (Poisson + 5% early Celtic red-card/collapse + 5% chaotic high-scoring game + slight LASK ET edge): realistic LASK ~45% Leg 2 win yields 0.930 Celtic qual; pre-tie bookmaker-anchored LASK ~38% yields 0.952; skeptic LASK ~50% yields 0.907. Historical UEFA 3-0 Leg 1 home-win advancement rate is ~94-95%. Blending 50/50 realistic + bookmaker-anchored mixture = 0.941 -> 0.94 UCL / 0.06 UEL.

football_and_world.title: Which country's public broadcaster will announce a boycott of Eurovision 2027 in August 2026 over concerns about the contest's political neutrality?

  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.
